text:
elaine: Thinking about adding a micro-slices view in Console for per-route token latency breakdowns. Want to show p50/p95/p99, throughput, error rate and a kernel-attribution bar. Thoughts?

matt: +1. we should definitely correlate with kernel choice and kv hit/miss. tiny prefix-length slices will help surface tail behavior.

priya: agree. also need to surface sample counts on each slice. p99 with <100 samples is pretty noisy. show sampling rate and an estimate of uncertainty.

leo: sampling policy question — do we do a steady reservoir (1%) or adaptive? my vote: baseline 1% + bump to 50% for requests that trigger KV miss / kernel fallback for a short window.

elaine: proposal: default reservoir 1% per-route, adaptive bump on kv_miss or kernel_fallback for 2 minutes. mark bumped samples in the UI and show unbumped vs bumped counts.

matt: quick telemetry example to get kernel attribution:
```
sum(rate(token_latency_count[5m])) by (route,prefix_len,kernel)

# then break into buckets for p50/p95/p99 per (route,prefix_len)
```

priya: from alerting POV: emit regression signals — if route.p99 increases > 20% vs baseline for 10m AND samples > 200 -> page. also track error_rate and qps dips.

leo: KV metrics to include: kv_hit_rate, kv_median_fetch_ms, kv_miss_tail_ms. KV miss patterns explain a lot of p99. if kv_miss correlates with a specific kernel, show that link.

infra-bot: telemetry: new schema v2 pushed to staging. includes labels: kernel, kv_hit, kv_latency_ms, prefix_len, model_variant, precision. Ingest service restarted: deploy-bot:ok

deploy-bot: deploy v2-telemetry -> staging successful :white_check_mark: (build 2026.03.16.12)

elaine: UI notes: small condensed card in route list: p50 / p95 / p99, qps, err%. clicking expands to micro-slices view: columns = prefix_len bucket, rows = kernel. hover shows sample count, avg token latency, kv_hit_rate.

matt: UX: add sparkline per slice (30m) + hover tooltip that includes delta vs baseline and sample count. small overlay to indicate when sampling was bumped.

priya: also add a toggle to show only stable samples (no adaptive bump) so SREs can compare production steady-state vs adaptive sampling.

elaine: do we want model_variant/precision as top-level filters? quantization changes kernel choices and latency.

leo: yes. add model_variant and precision/quantization label. make them filterable and included in telemetry rollups.

elaine: ok i'll draft a spec: telemetry ingestion details, sampling rules, alerting thresholds, UI mockups. tagging @matt @priya for review. will include a small PromQL/Influx example and a runbook note about noisy p99. thanks everyone :eyes:

matt: thanks, ping me when draft is ready. :+1:

priya: lgtm, will review for alert wording and thresholds.

infra-bot: note: metric cardinality alert will trigger if prefix_len x kernel x model_variant combos exceed safe limits. please coordinate if you add more labels.

elaine: noted — i'll keep label set minimal and use rollups. next step: spec + mockups in product board.
